player_0.content: New plan: I overestimated the intensity of emotions that Reggie would feel. Upon re-reading the dialogue, I realize that Reggie's tone is more defensive and sarcastic than vindicated. Reggie's responses, such as "What's that supposed to mean?" and "I'll believe it when I see it", suggest that he is annoyed and frustrated with Marcus's skepticism. Reggie's attempt to downplay the corporate gala and emphasize the intimate nature of his party idea also implies that he is annoyed by Marcus's dismissive attitude. In contrast, Reggie's insecurity is not explicitly expressed in the dialogue, and his euphoric tone is not present at all. Next time, I will focus on accurately capturing Reggie's defensive and sarcastic tone, and assign higher scores to Annoyed and lower scores to Vindicated, Insecure, and Euphoric.
